name: Associated Bus Company Plc (ABC Transport PLC)
source: ABC Transport Plc audited consolidated and separate annual report and financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, filed with the Nigerian Exchange (NGX disclosure library), Group column, read in full on 25 September 2026: statement of financial position page 19, statement of profit or loss page 20, statement of cash flows page 23 and the five-year financial summary page 89 | key alias copy from ABCTRANS (same security, older symbol)

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.note: printed administrative expenses line of the issuer

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: stored negative, the convention of this file, where profit before tax plus this row equals net profit in every period
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: EPS
rows.note: printed basic and diluted earnings per share, converted from kobo to naira per share

note: Rebuilt 25 September 2026 from the audited FY2025 report of the issuer. FY2025 and FY2024 are the printed Group lines of the statement of profit or loss. FY2023 to FY2021 are the printed Group lines of the five-year financial summary on page 89 of the same report. Operating Profit (EBIT) is printed for FY2025 and FY2024 and derived for FY2023 to FY2021 as profit before tax plus finance costs, the identity that ties exactly in both printed years. Revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, and profit before tax plus the stored income tax row equals net profit, in all five periods. Operating Expenses is the printed administrative expenses line; gross profit less that line does not equal the printed operating profit because other operating income and net fair value gains sit above it in the statement.
derivedCellsNote: Rows tagged derived are arithmetic on the printed inputs of this file, each with its formula.
alias_basis: ABC Transport Plc was formerly Associated Bus Company Limited and the Nigerian Exchange lists the security only under ABCTRANS, so this key resolves to the same security under an older symbol
